**You can apply right now for four open research grants; their application deadlines are shown below.**  

| Grant (code) | Title | Amount | Application deadline | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GR‑AI‑01 | AI for Social Good Research Fellowship | ₹1,50,000 | 20 Dec 2026 | open |
| GR‑ML‑02 | Undergraduate Machine Learning Research Assistantship | ₹60,000 | 10 Jan 2027 | open |
| GR‑CY‑03 | Cybersecurity Research Scholarship | ₹75,000 | 31 Jan 2027 | open |
| GR‑SUS‑08 | Sustainability & Green Computing Grant | ₹70,000 | 28 Feb 2027 | open |

*All four grants match your profile (CS department, Year 3, CGPA 9.5) – e.g., CGPA 9.5 ≥ 8.5 for GR‑AI‑01 [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §3 Grant‑specific eligibility > GR‑AI‑01]; CGPA 9.5 ≥ 9.0 for GR‑ML‑02 [Doc: … > GR‑ML‑02]; etc. The policy check confirms eligibility for each listed grant.*  

**Closed or upcoming grants:**  
- Closed (cannot apply): GR‑HW‑06 (deadline 15 Dec 2026) and GR‑ROB‑12 (deadline 31 Dec 2026) – status **closed** [SQL].  
- Upcoming (will open later): GR‑HC‑10 (opens 05 Jan 2027) and GR‑SP‑14 (opens 01 Dec 2026) – status **upcoming** [SQL].

**Next steps:** Prepare the required documents for each open grant (research proposal, grade card, etc.) and submit before the listed deadline. All applications must be submitted while the grant status is **open** (Rule 5, §2) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §2 General eligibility rules].
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-AI-01', 'GR-CY-03', 'GR-ML-02', 'GR-SUS-08', 'GR-ROB-12', 'GR-SP-14', 'GR-HC-10', 'GR-HW-06']) ORDER BY application_deadline
